package logcalls
import "{{MODULE}}/internal/base/logging"
func Calls(l *logging.Logger) {
 l.Infow("message", "key") // want loggercheck
 l.Errorw("message", 1, "value") // want loggercheck
 l.Debugw("message", "key") // want loggercheck
 l.Warnw("message", "key") // want loggercheck
 l.With("key") // want loggercheck
}
